steps.title: Lock the Edge product scope and migration plan
steps.summary: Deliver: an agreed year-one Edge product scope and release sequence; a minimum live-service specification for the existing platform; a prioritised backlog covering events, self-paced activity, projects and sustained experiences; data, content and migration maps; the in-house badging requirements and Accredible exit plan; the bounded King’s Canvas prototype scope; and clear product, operational and acceptance responsibilities. Complete this definition during November and December 2026 as the core multidisciplinary team becomes available.

steps.title: Replatform the live Edge service and activity model
steps.summary: Deliver: an Azure-hosted production version of the core Edge service; migration of the opportunity catalogue and required historical records; a flexible activity model for events, self-paced activity, projects and sustained experiences; student search, discovery, registration, attendance and participation journeys; cohort restrictions and targeted curation; activity-owner administration; communications, reporting and audit trails; and a tested cutover and continuity plan. Begin this work in January 2027 in parallel with completion of the wider Azure delivery foundations, using jointly agreed interim standards and aligning them as the shared patterns mature.

steps.title: Deliver in-house digital badging and retire Accredible
steps.summary: Deliver: a production in-house digital-badging service; badge-definition and issuer administration; automatic and manual issuance; verified self-claim and off-platform recognition routes; student badge display; public verification; revocation, audit and reporting; support and service ownership; migration of required issuers, badge definitions and credential records from Accredible; and a validated cutover completed by the end of August 2027 so the subscription can be stood down before renewal. Run this as a parallel deadline-led workstream rather than waiting for the wider Edge launch.

steps.title: Put projects, wider experiences and King’s Canvas into controlled use
steps.summary: Deliver: project and sustained-experience records; milestones and progress tracking; resource hosting; participant groups; submissions and outputs; collections and pathways; provider curation; self-paced participation; participant communications; student evidence upload and staff verification; and a saved, revisitable King’s Canvas prototype covering needs and aspirations, bounded AI coaching and links into the live opportunity catalogue. Release these capabilities into controlled use, capture student and staff evidence, and produce a prioritised list of fixes and hardening requirements for launch.

steps.title: Launch the connected Edge-led Hub kernel
steps.summary: Deliver: one coherent live Edge experience joining opportunity discovery, registration, participation, project and experience management, Canvas, evidence and digital badging; completed accessibility, security and performance assurance; live product analytics; operating documentation; support, incident and maintenance arrangements; named service ownership; and an adoption and transition plan for students and activity providers. The Accredible exit remains an earlier August 2027 deadline and is not held back by this wider launch.

steps.title: Connect planning, opportunity, participation, evidence and recognition
steps.summary: Deliver: stronger movement from Canvas needs and aspirations into relevant opportunities; connections from activity progress and completion into evidence and recognition; proportionate post-activity reflection; collections and pathways that support progression from lighter-touch to deeper experiences; and the Edge recognition changes required by the proposition led through 2.4.3, using the skills, governance and assurance inputs supplied through 2.1.3 and 2.2.3. Prioritise changes using evidence from live year-one use.

steps.title: Move Edge fully into the shared student app
steps.summary: Deliver: Edge within the shared student-app home, navigation, profile, search, communications and interaction patterns; migration from Edge-specific functions to common Hub capabilities where they meet the need; continuity of student records and journeys; and a selective Edge product roadmap focused on opportunity quality, Canvas, projects, evidence and recognition. Retain Edge ownership of its proposition, content, curation, developmental journeys and recognition rules.

steps.title: Complete the transition of Edge into a mature Hub domain
steps.summary: Deliver: a stable Edge product domain operating through shared app, data, integration, profile, communication and service capabilities; enduring product and service ownership; a routine analytics and continuous-improvement cycle; retirement of redundant Edge-specific components where continuity is assured; and a controlled route for later portfolio, articulation and enhanced-record capabilities when the propositions led through 2.4.3 and the necessary data foundations are mature.
